text:
## Policy Statement  
**FirstUK Bank does not knowingly provide banking services to individuals or entities engaged in or suspected of money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions violations, or other financial crime.**

properties.name: Anti-Money Laundering and Financial Crime Policy

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank does not knowingly provide banking services to individuals or entities engaged in or suspected of money laundering, terrorist financing, sanctions violations, or other financial crime.

properties.risk_definition: The process by which individuals or entities conceal the origins of illegally obtained funds by integrating them into the financial system
The provision of financial support or resources to individuals or entities engaged in or suspected of terrorist activities
Provision of banking services to individuals or entities subject to international or domestic sanctions restrictions
Illegal activities conducted through or facilitated by the financial system, including but not limited to money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions violations
